title: How do HTML forms work, and why should inputs always have associated labels?
expectedConcepts: Input types (text, email, password, checkbox, radio, submit)
Label pairing with id and htmlFor/for
hints: How does clicking on the label text help mobile users?
Which attribute connects a label to an input’s id?

codingExercise.instruction: Write the HTML markup for an accessible text input for "Username" with an associated label.
codingExercise.expectedOutput: Connected label with for="username" and input with id="username"
